sentences.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her skillet.
sentences.zh: Ziri 向 Rima 借她的煎锅。

sentences.en: It took me three hours of scrubbing to clean the skillet.
sentences.zh: 我花了三个小时才把那口煎锅刷干净。

sentences.en: What Khalid really loved was the sizzle of bacon in the skillet.
sentences.zh: Khalid 最喜欢的是煎锅里培根发出的嘶嘶声。
